Folding screens develop more noticeable creases over time, but Apple's Kate Bergeron says the iPhone Duo's folding display uses a replaceable protective layer to help address this issue.

The iPhone Duo's folding screen 'protective layer' can be replaced over time, keeping it looking like new

Following the iPhone Duo's unveiling last month, Apple executives sat down for an interview to explain why the company deliberately focused on improving durability while reducing the crease problem that plagues other foldable phones.

As part of these efforts, the iPhone Duo appears to have a unique design feature to ensure it still feels 'like new' after years of use: the folding display uses a replaceable protective layer.

Below is the interview with Apple's Vice President of Hardware Engineering, Kate Bergeron, conducted by the TikTok account @angietutorials:

You can watch the full clip on TikTok.

Apple mentions this 'protective layer' in the AppleCare estimated repair cost table for the iPhone Duo. As Quinn Nelson discovered, replacing the protective layer under AppleCare coverage costs $19. The cost without AppleCare has not yet been announced.

So if you're worried about spending over $2,000 on an iPhone Duo only to find the screen crease becoming more obvious over time, it sounds like Apple already has a solution.

Are you worried about the crease issue on the iPhone Duo? Let us know in the comments.
